CONFIDENTIAL
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
File No.
CONFIDENTIAL
REPORT
DRAWER
S. Spt. RLC. Station,
S. B. D. 1622.
Date February 19, 19 31.
23 - 2 - 31
Subject (in full) Sidney Joseph Halse.
Made by and Forwarded by D.S.I. Duncan.
Sir,
Enquiries show that Sidney Joseph Halse, British,
unmarried, has been a resident of Shanghai for over twenty
three years. Until a few years ago he was a partner of
the firm of Moorhead & Halse, Civil Engineers, Architects
& Surveyors.
Halse formerly resided with a Japanese woman
at No. 8 Peitaiho Lane during which time he led a quiet
retiring life. Since retiring from business, he has been
in the habit of spending most of his time in Japan and while
there he is known to have made a practice of seducing young
Japanese girls, in fact, he openly boasts of his ability to
have carnal knowledge of any Japanese girl he takes a fancy
to. While residing in Shanghai, he is not known to pursue
such practices.
On the occasion of Halse's arrest in September
1930 by the Japanese Authorities at Nagasaki, a Japanese
friend named T. Ota, Building Contractor, residing at No.
F.92 Bubbling Well Road, proceeded to Japan and is reported
to have assisted in securing the dismissal of the case.
Halse has been a member of the Shanghai Club
since 1907. He is also a member of the Shanghai Race Club,
but takes little or no part in the social life of the city.
He has very few intimate friends outside the circle of men
of his own profession.
Apart from the fact that Halse's immoral practices
are well known, there is nothing further known to his detriment.

主题（全称） Sidney Joseph Halse。
由副督察 Duncan 制作并转发。
先生，
经查，Sidney Joseph Halse，英籍，
未婚，已在上海居住二十三年有余。直到几年前，他还是
Moorhead & Halse 公司的合伙人，该公司从事土木工程、建筑设计与测量业务。
Halse 此前曾与一名日本女子同居于北太和里8号，在此期间他过着安静隐居的生活。自商界退休后，他习惯将大部分时间花在日本，众所周知，他在那里惯常诱奸年轻的日本女孩，事实上，他公然吹嘘自己有能力与任何他看上的日本女孩发生性关系。在上海居住期间，未闻他有此类行径。
1930年9月 Halse 在长崎被日本当局逮捕时，一位名叫 T. Ota 的日本朋友（建筑承包商，住静安寺路 F.92 号）前往日本，据报协助促成了该案的撤销。
Halse 自1907年起即为上海总会会员。他也是上海跑马总会会员，但很少或几乎不参与城市的社交生活。除了同行圈子外，他几乎没有亲密朋友。
除了 Halse 的不道德行为众所周知这一事实外，未发现其他对他不利的情况。

page_data.en:
October 9, 1930    Morning Translation

MISCELLANEOUS

ALLEGATIONS AGAINST A BRITISH SUBJECT

The Shanghai Nippo publishes the following
report:-
A British subject named Halse, 53, a building
contractor by profession, residing in French Town,
always spends his Summer holidays at Nagasaki. There
he has seduced more than 10 Japanese girls of from 12
to 13 years of age. One of his victims is now pregnant.
Several of the girls have brought a charge of seduction
against him in the Nagasaki Police Court.
A Japanese named Ota, a friend of Halse, went to
Nagasaki from Shanghai and made arrangements to settle
the matter with the complainants by payment of various
sums of money.
The police now intend to deport Halse because his
behavior is bringing disgrace to Japan.

A FOREIGN LIBERTINE ARRESTED AT NAGASAKI.

The Shanghai Nippo of 27/9/30 publishes the
following report:-
A British subject named "Haroha," 36, residing
in French Town, goes to Japan every year during Summer.
He built a house on the Yamate Cho, Nagasaki at a
cost of Yen 25,000. He became a notorious libertine.
He has been arrested by the Nagasaki Police and is under-
going Police examination.
It is stated that the man had violated about 100
young Japanese girls of 12 to 13 years of age including
girl students and that he had also seduced the wives of
several Japanese.
page_data.zh:
1930年10月9日    晨间译文

杂项

针对一名英籍人士的指控

《上海日报》（Shanghai Nippo）刊登如下报道：
一名名为 Halse 的英籍人士，53岁，职业为建筑承包商，居住在法租界，总是在长崎度过暑假。在那里，他诱奸了十多名年龄在12至13岁的日本女孩。其中一名受害者现已怀孕。几名女孩已在长崎警察法庭对他提起诱奸指控。
一名名为 Ota 的日本人，是 Halse 的朋友，从上海前往长崎，安排通过支付各种款项与原告和解此事。
警方现在打算驱逐 Halse，因为他的行为给日本带来了耻辱。

一名外国放荡者在长崎被捕。

1930年9月27日的《上海日报》刊登如下报道：
一名名为“Haroha”的英籍人士，36岁，居住在法租界，每年夏季都去日本。他在长崎山手町（Yamate Cho）花费25,000日元建造了一所房屋。他成了臭名昭著的放荡者。他已被长崎警方逮捕，正在接受警方审讯。
据称，该男子侵犯了约100名12至13岁的年轻日本女孩，包括女学生，并且还诱奸了几名日本人的妻子。

page_data.en:
Copy.
British Consulate,
Nagasaki.
October 11, 1930.

Dear Consulate-General,

Sidney Joseph Halse, bearer of Shang-
hai passport No.5649 of 22/3/29, now staying at the
Shanghai
Japan Hotel, Nagasaki, and giving his address as
207, Little House, Connaught Road, has been under
examination at the Japanese Court in connection with
a case of suspected rape, and, now that the case has
been dismissed by the Procurator, he has complained to
me of mistreatment, etc., stating that he proposes to
devote all his fortune and energies to obtaining
redress and clearing his reputation.

I shall do my utmost to avoid official intervention,
but shall have to take some sort of action if he supports
his allegations that he has been refused access to me,
that he is still under police restraint in spite of
the case having been dismissed, etc. I should therefore
be grateful if you would kindly supply me, for my
guidance, with any information, private or official,
that you may have as to this man.

My sole connection with him, up to the present
time, was in April last year, when I attested his
/Declaration
page_data.zh:
副本。
英国领事馆，
长崎。
1930年10月11日。

尊敬的总领事，

Sidney Joseph Halse，持有1929年3月22日签发的上海护照第5649号，现住在
上海
长崎日本酒店，其地址为康纳特路 Little House 207号，因涉嫌强奸案正在
日本法院接受审讯，鉴于检察官已撤销此案，他向我抱怨受到虐待等，
声称他打算倾尽所有财富和精力以获得补救并洗清名誉。

我将尽力避免官方干预，但如果他坚持声称我被拒绝与他见面，
尽管案件已撤销他仍受到警方限制等指控，我将不得不采取某种行动。因此，
如果您能 kindly 提供您可能掌握的关于此人的任何私人或官方
信息以供我参考，我将不胜感激。

到目前为止，我与他的唯一联系是在去年四月，当时我见证了他的
/声明

page_data.en:
2.

Declaration for refund of Income Tax and ascertained
that he was only a visitor to Nagasaki. From local
gossip I have gathered that he has been visiting
Nagasaki for many years and that he makes a practice
of the seduction of young Japanese girls, whom he
then dismisses with lavish payment to themselves
and/or their parents. So far as I know he has never
entered into social relations with any of the foreign
community except a few men who use the Japan Hotel,
and I have heard that the question of proposing him
for the Club was once brought up but dismissed on
account of his reputation.

I trust it may not be necessary for me to obtain
official details of the present case, but according to
my present understanding of it the Police, having long
known his mode of life, took action because they thought
the evidence of certain girls' parents would suffice
for criminal proceedings, but had to drop it because
the evidence failed.

Yours ever,
(Signed) F.C. Greatrex.
page_data.zh:
2.

退还所得税声明，并确认
他只是长崎的游客。从当地流言中我得知，
他多年来一直访问长崎，并惯常诱奸年轻的日本女孩，
随后向她们本人和/或其父母支付巨额钱财以打发她们。据我所知，
除了少数使用日本酒店的男子外，他从未与任何外籍社区成员
建立社交关系，我还听说曾有人提议让他加入俱乐部，但因
其名声不佳而被驳回。

我希望不必由我去获取当前案件的官方细节，但根据我目前的了解，
警方因长期知晓他的生活方式而采取行动，因为他们认为某些女孩父母的
证词足以提起刑事诉讼，但因证据不足而不得不放弃。

您永远的，
（签名） F.C. Greatrex.

page_data.en:
Copy.
Confidential.
British Consulat-General,
Shanghai.
17th. October 1930.

My dear Greatrex,
Your letter of October 11th.
Mr. Sidney Joseph Halse was formerly a
member of a firm of architects in Shanghai
called Moorhead, Halse and Robinson, but apart
from the information contained in his passport
which you have seen, I have not been able to
ascertain very little regarding him locally.
A member of his former firm tells me that he
knows nothing about him beyond the fact that he
lives a very retired life in Shanghai, does not
take part in any social activities and keeps a
Japanese woman.
There is no evidence of his having
indulged in the proclivities mentioned in
your letter.
Yours sincerely,
(Signed) J.I. Brenan.

F.C. Greatrex, Esquire,
H.B.M. Consul,
Nagasaki.
page_data.zh:
副本。
机密。
英国驻上海总领事馆，
1930年10月17日。

亲爱的 Greatrex，
您10月11日的来信。
Sidney Joseph Halse 先生曾是上海一家名为
Moorhead, Halse and Robinson 的建筑师事务所的成员，但除了
您已见过的护照中所载信息外，我在本地未能
查明关于他的更多情况。
他前事务所的一名成员告诉我，除了知道他
在上海过着非常隐居的生活，不参与任何社交活动，并包养
一名日本女子外，对他一无所知。
没有证据表明他沉溺于
您信中提到的那些癖好。
您真诚的，
（签名） J.I. Brenan.

F.C. Greatrex 先生，
英国陛下领事，
长崎。

page_data.en:
COPY
Private and Confidential
British Consulate
Nagasaki.
January 28 1931.

Dear Brenan,
Thanks for yours of Oct.17th re S.J.HALSE.
I was reserving my reply till there were develop-
ments worth reporting.
Halse left here for Shanghai last week, with
the avowed intention of returning to Japan in about
two months, the validity of his Japanese visa expiring
early in April. His lawyer, who is preparing the
case for legal proceedings against the Local Author-
ities and newspapers, seems to have assured him that
on the strength of his visa and a local official's
certificate of Nagasaki domicile his re-entry cannot
be prevented, but I have been assured privately that
every precaution will be taken at all ports to prevent
him landing, and the opinion of the Embassy's legal
adviser (which was communicated to him before he left)
is that the Japanese Govt. at all times possess the
right to decide whether or no foreigners may enter or
/continue
page_data.zh:
副本
私人且机密
英国领事馆
长崎。
1931年1月28日。

亲爱的 Brenan，
感谢您10月17日关于 S.J.HALSE 的来信。
我一直保留回复，直到有值得报告的进展。
Halse 上周离开此地前往上海，
公开宣称约两个月后返回日本，他的日本签证将于
四月初到期。他的律师正在准备针对地方当局
和报纸的法律诉讼案件，似乎向他保证，凭借他的签证和
当地官员出具的长崎居住证明，他的再次入境不会被阻止，但我私下获悉，
各港口将采取一切预防措施防止他登陆，且大使馆法律顾问的意见
（在他离开前已传达给他）是，日本政府始终拥有决定外国人是否可以进入或
/继续

page_data.en:
2.
continue to reside in Japan, and it is not within
their competence to divest themselves of that right.
Therefore, wherever he may try to land, and fail,
the Consul can do no more than obtain an official
explanation of the prohibition and convey it to him
reporting the facts to the Embassy. He will then
presumably return to Shanghai and attack you. It
would be interesting to know what his next step
will be when you tell him that you have no means
of intervening. He admits to enjoying what he
calls "bumping up against authority" (as he claims
to have done successfully in Shanghai on more than
one occasion), and with his leisure and ample means
he will stop at nothingin endeavouring to prove
that he has been illegally treated by the Japanese
Authorities and let down by his Consul.
I consider Halse has a legitimate grievance
against the Police because in practice his situation
at the hotel after dismissal of the case against
him did amount to restriction of his liberty, at all
/events
page_data.zh:
2.
继续在日本居住的权利，他们无权放弃这一权利。
因此，无论他试图在哪里登陆并被拒绝，
领事除了获得禁止令的官方解释并转达给他，
同时向大使馆报告事实外，无能为力。届时他
可能会返回上海并攻击您。当您告诉他您无法
进行干预时，了解他的下一步行动将会很有趣。他承认喜欢
他所谓的“与权威碰撞”（他声称在上海已成功做到过不止一次），
凭借他的闲暇和充裕财力，他将不择手段地试图证明
他受到了日本当局的非法对待，并且被他的领事抛弃。
我认为 Halse 对警方有正当的不满，因为实际上，
在针对他的案件撤销后，他在酒店的处境确实构成了对其自由的限制，至少
/在各方面

page_data.en:
3.
events for some days. I therefore made an offic-
ial protest on this ground to the Local Authority,
but the Governor takes the stand that there was no
technical 'detention' and that Halse and the people
at the hotel must have misunderstood the intentions
of the Police, which were directed (1) towards
preventing him meeting enemies liable to attack him,
and (2) towards preventing him from resuming immoral
relations with young girls of a kind that they are
satisfied he has previously engaged in and that,
though not indictable, constitute a breach of public
decency. There is little doubt that the real
official plan was to make things as uncomfortable
as possible for him in the hope that he would quit,
instead of which the effect was merely to make him
more and more determined to have somebody's blood.
He is of course highly incensed against me for fail-
ing to get satisfaction from the Governor, and blames
me for delay in taking official action, the fact
being that for months my official action was deferred
with his approval because he thought he could get
the Authorities to rehabilitate his reputation by
private negotiations.
/The
page_data.zh:
3.
在几天内是这样。因此，我以此为由向地方当局提出了正式抗议，
但总督坚持认为不存在技术意义上的“拘留”，Halse 和酒店人员
一定误解了警方的意图，警方的意图是 (1) 防止他接触可能攻击他的敌人，
以及 (2) 防止他与年轻女孩恢复不道德关系，警方确信他以前曾从事此类行为，
虽然不可起诉，但构成违反公共道德。毫无疑问，真正的
官方计划是让他的日子尽可能难过，希望他会离开，
然而结果只是让他更加决心要让某人付出代价。
当然，他对我未能从总督那里获得满意结果感到极度愤怒，并指责我
延迟采取官方行动，事实是，数月来我的官方行动经他同意而推迟，
因为他认为可以通过私人谈判使当局恢复他的名誉。
/The

page_data.en:
4.

The Shanghai address he has left with me is
c/o Spence, Robinson and Partners,
3 Peking Road,
I know Spence quite well, and hope he is not
intimately associated with a man of Halse's reput-
ation. The latter's firm was not the same that
Spence joined when he left the O/W, was it?
Yours sincerely,

(Signed) F.C.Greatrex.
page_data.zh:
4.

他留给我的上海地址是
转交 Spence, Robinson and Partners,
北京路3号，
我很了解 Spence，希望他没有与像 Halse 这样名声的人
有密切关联。后者的事务所不是 Spence 离开 O/W 时加入的那家吧？
您真诚的，

（签名） F.C.Greatrex.

page_data.en:
SECRET & CONFIDENTIAL
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
Headquarters, S.B.
REPORT
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
C. & S. B. REGISTRY
No. S2 B. D. Station, 1622
Date October 8, 1930
Subject (in full) Further report re British subject named Halse.
Made by C. D. I. Nakagawa Forwarded by Jno Robertson Supt.
In connection with Halse's case at Nagasaki, Mr. Okatsu,
passport examiner on the S.S. Shanghai Maru, informed me on
October 7 that five Japanese victims had lodged a complaint of
seduction against Halse at the Nagasaki Police Court. The
accused denied the charges. A Japanese named T. Ota, a
building contractor, who is a friend of the accused, residing
at No. F.92 Bubbling Well Road, went to Nagasaki after the
arrest of Halse and succeeded in securing his release on
October 4. The case has been withdrawn for lack of evidence.
Halse is now staying at the Japan Hotel at Nagasaki. The
Police are still keeping a close watch on him and they may
order him to leave Japan if they receive definite instructions
from the Home Office.
S. Nakagawa
C. D. I.
（批：Stuy）
（批：OCT: 1930 C.）
(Crime and Special Branches)
E. L. P.
Information.
（批：M 11:10:30）
（批：M 8:10:30.）
page_data.zh:
秘密且机密
上海公共租界工部局警务处。
总部，S.B.
报告
上海公共租界工部局警务处
刑事与特务科登记处
No. S2 B. D. 分局, 1622
日期 1930年10月8日
主题（全称） 关于名为 Halse 的英籍人士的进一步报告。
由中川副督察制作，由 Jno Robertson 警司转发。
关于 Halse 在长崎的案件，“上海丸”轮船上的护照检查员 Okatsu 先生于
10月7日告知我，有五名日本受害者在长崎警察法庭对 Halse 提起了诱奸投诉。
被告否认了这些指控。一名名为 T. Ota 的日本人（建筑承包商），是被告的朋友，
居住在静安寺路 F.92 号，在 Halse 被捕后前往长崎，并于
10月4日成功促成其获释。该案因证据不足已撤销。
Halse 现住在长崎的日本酒店。警方仍在严密监视他，如果收到内务省的明确指示，

The Shanghai Nippo publishes the following
report:-
A British subject named "Haroha,"36, residing
in French Town, goes to Japan every year during Summer.
He built a house on the Yamate Cho, Nagasaki at a
cost of Yen 25,000. He became a notorious libertine.
He has been arrested by the Nagasaki Police and is under-
going Police examination.
It is stated that the man had violated about 100
young Japanese girls of 12 to 13 years of age including
girl students and that he had also seduced the wives of
several Japanese.

《上海日报》（Shanghai Nippo）刊登如下报道：-
一名名为“Haroha”（音译）、36岁、居住在法租界的英国臣民，每年夏季都会前往日本。他在长崎山手町建造了一栋房屋，耗资25,000日元。他已成为臭名昭著的放荡者。他已被长崎警方逮捕，正在接受警方审讯。
据悉，该男子强奸了约100名年龄在12至13岁的日本年轻女孩，其中包括女学生，并且还诱奸了几名日本人的妻子。

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE FILES REGISTRY No. S. B. D. 7622/38 Date December 9, 1938）
Date December 9, 1938.
Subject S. J. Halse. - application to Japanese Consulate-General
for a visa to Japan.
Made by D.S.I. MacAdie Forwarded by C. Caspa D. I.

In accordance with the instructions of the Commissioner
of Police, D.S.I. MacAdie and D.S. Kamashita, at 3 p.m.,
December 8th, accompanied Mr. Sidney Joseph HALSE, British,
to the Japanese Consulate-General, Passport Department.
Halse's application for a visa to visit Japan was accepted
and the communication received by him from the Nagasaki
District Court where he is engaged in litigation, was copied
down by the Passport Office for reference. The passport
officials then stated that the facts would be referred
telegraphically to the Gaimusho for decision and that they
would inform Mr. Halse in the course of a few days as to the
course to be taken in connection with his proposed visit to
Japan.

Halse stated that the civil action taken by him against
some fifteen Japanese newspapers for libel was set for
hearing on December 24th, 1938.

The Special Branch detectives returned to Central
District with Mr. Halse at 3.30 p.m.

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE 10 DEC. 1933 COMMISSIONER'S OFFICE）

日期 1938年12月9日。

制作人 D.S.I. 麦卡迪（MacAdie） 转呈人 C. 卡斯帕（Caspa） 督察

遵照警务处处长的指示，12月8日下午3点，D.S.I. 麦卡迪和 D.S. 釜下（Kamashita，音译）陪同英国人西德尼·约瑟夫·哈尔斯（Sidney Joseph HALSE）前往日本总领事馆护照科。哈尔斯赴日旅游签证的申请已被受理，他从正在涉诉的长崎地方法院收到的信函已由护照办公室抄录备案。护照官员随后表示，相关事实将通过电报上报外务省（Gaimusho）以待裁决，并将在几天内通知哈尔斯先生关于其拟议访日事宜的后续步骤。

哈尔斯表示，他对约十五家日本报纸提起的诽谤民事诉讼定于1938年12月24日开庭审理。

特别处侦探于下午3点30分随同哈尔斯先生返回中央巡捕房。
